tiles.rule: The headline of the Israel and Palestine card, which tags each of its items by direction.

"No" when nothing found in his record points toward ICE; "Mostly no" when at least three times as many items point the other way. Toward enforcement: 4 votes and 0 statements or actions. Against: 6 votes and 6 statements or actions.
"Mixed" when at least 3 picked votes point each way. He cast 8 on the police or tough-on-crime side and 3 against.
His votes decide the headline: 5 of the 9 business, finance and labor votes picked went the business way (a third or fewer is "Mostly no", two thirds or more "Mostly yes").
His vote on the Epstein Files Transparency Act, which passed 427–1 (roll 2025-289).
